{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    color = next(v for v in counts if v != bg)
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if out[r0][c] == bg: out[r0][c]=color
        if out[r1][c] == bg: out[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if out[r][c0] == bg: out[r][c0]=color
        if out[r][c1] == bg: out[r][c1]=color
    return out
",
 "path": "programs/task-853df2b5.py"
}
